identity_lock: Edit the provided reference image as the same individual pet. Preserve the same face structure, eye placement, base anatomy, recognizable silhouette, visual personality and established markings. Do not reinterpret it as a new character.
base_style: Premium Galaxy Fantasy Chibi game character art. Cute compact proportions, large expressive eyes, soft fluffy fur, clean readable silhouette, refined soft lighting, subtle nebula gradients, tiny restrained star details, elegant celestial glow, polished mobile-game character quality. Galaxy details must feel integrated into the pet rather than painted everywhere.
preserve_rule: Keep every established feature that is not explicitly named in CHANGE ONLY unchanged. Do not redesign unrelated anatomy, pose family, camera angle, face identity, color structure or existing mutation details.
negative_prompt: different character, identity drift, changed face, changed camera angle, changed pose family, unrelated redesign, photorealistic, realistic animal anatomy, horror, grotesque, deformed anatomy, extra limbs, extra ears, duplicate tail, excessive galaxy texture, stars covering the entire body, noisy pattern, muddy colors, text, logo, watermark
